contract: Caller-supplied pure payload transformation re-wrapped at an explicit output Port, preserving intrinsic metadata/idempotency and dropping sequence.

telemetry.contract: No observations; invoking Unit/Assembly owns instrumentation.

config.contract: Intrinsic data and caller function, no ambient settings or hot reconfiguration.
